semantics.clock: All sequential updates occur on the positive edge, as explicitly specified.
semantics.load: Active-high synchronous load replaces q with data at that edge; otherwise advance one timestep.
semantics.evolution: All cells update simultaneously using eight neighbours in the preceding q. Counts 0/1 or 4..8 yield zero, count 2 preserves the cell, count 3 yields one.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior specified.
semantics.initialization: No initial state specified; leave q uninitialized until a load. Verification of game evolution starts with an explicit load.
semantics.topology: 16 by 16 torus; both row and column wrap modulo 16.

numeric.mapping: Cell (row,column) maps to q[16*row+column]; q[15:0] is row 0.
numeric.neighbour_count: Unsigned integer in range 0 through 8; exclude the cell itself.

verification.oracle: Independent nested offset loops count the eight neighbours from a saved state per original problem.
verification.sampling: Drive load and data while clock is low; verify q stays stable before the rising edge and compare after nonblocking updates settle.
verification.cases: Synchronous load priority, repeated loads, empty/full grids, all counts for dead/live center cells, wraparound corner oscillator and block, isolated cells, deterministic random grids and multicycle trajectories.
verification.completion: Fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS after all checks.

specification_ambiguities: Power-up q is unspecified; no defined startup value is imposed or tested.
Behaviour for X/Z inputs is unspecified; functional comparisons use binary states after synchronous load.
